title: Wonderful view and the paella, of course
text: I booked the class on the rooftop while I was traveling across Spain and stayed in Sevilla for two days. The experience was excellent: the place with the view, the host Fernando and of course paella, which we have made with the group together. I highly recommend to try it if you are planning to go to Sevilla.
author: Елена О

title: Amazing!
text: We had a great experience. I could not recommend this more! The rooftop has beautiful views - probably the best in the city! The host was prepared and lots of fun. We made paella and Sangria. There were also lots of fun surprises along the way. If you are in Sevilla - this is a must fo!
author: Jourdan S

title: Sevilla food experiences was amazing!
text: Wonderful instructors and great food with an unforgettable view. They’re extremely hospitable and helpful. An excellent experience that you have to do when visiting Sevilla!
author: jaimeeballas

title: Paella
text: What a fun evening! Amazing view, amazing drink, tapas, and dinner and I learned a family paella recipe! What could be better?!
author: Rachel L
